claim_nb: Huset er ca. 6 × 3 m utvendig.
claim_en: The house is about 6 × 3 m on the outside.
source: PROJECT.md · Base de diseño (Planta); fase1/registro-decisiones.md · A
allowed_en: about 6 × 3 m · approximately 3 × 6 metres
notes: C-02 is open: final dimensions and overhangs are not fixed. No dimension is ever taken from the concept images (registro §F, note 2). The story page writes «omtrent 3 × 6 meter» in Carlos's own words; the order of the two numbers does not change the size.

claim_nb: Grunnflaten er ca. 18 m².
claim_en: The footprint is about 18 m².
allowed_en: about 18 m² footprint
notes: Gross outer area only. Never «BRA», «bruksareal», «boareal» or «18 m² å bo i»: 18 m² is not usable floor area.

claim_nb: Huset har stålramme og gjenbrukt tre.
claim_en: The house has a steel frame and reclaimed timber.
source: PROJECT.md · Base de diseño (Acero y madera); knowledge/comparisons/module-brief.md §3
allowed_en: steel frame, reclaimed timber
notes: The chassis is R0 conceptual; the steel section is undefined (fase1/geometria-R0.md). Say «stålramme», not a steel grade.

claim_nb: Huset har saltak i metall.
claim_en: The house has a metal gable roof.
allowed_en: metal gable roof (concept)
notes: Pitch is not fixed. At 20° the roof conflicts with the 4.00 m transport height (registro §M, §N). Never publish a pitch, a rise or a ridge height.

claim_nb: Målet er at huset skal kunne flyttes i ett stykke med lastebil og kran.
claim_en: The goal is that the house can be moved in one piece by truck and crane.
allowed_nb: «Målet er at huset skal kunne flyttes i ett stykke.»
allowed_en: The goal is to move the house in one piece.
notes: No route, crane, spreader or lift plan is verified. 4.00 m is a screening height from S022, not a permit. The hero title «Et lite hus, laget for å flyttes.» (D12) states this goal as intent, not as a capability: never write «et hus som kan flyttes», «klar til løft» or «kan løftes i dag».

claim_nb: Gjenbrukt tre brukes i kledning og overflater, ikke som bærende konstruksjon.
claim_en: Reclaimed timber is used in cladding and finishes, not as load-bearing structure.
allowed_en: Reclaimed timber in cladding and finishes.
notes: Cladding and finishes is the default role in the module brief, but nothing is built and C-08 (the timber lot) is open. Say «kledning og overflater», never «bærende»; structural use needs documented species, grade, moisture, defects and connections.

claim_nb: Kledningen er gammel malmfuru (kjerneved).
claim_en: The cladding is old heartwood pine (malmfuru).
allowed_en: We are looking for old malmfuru.
notes: C-08 is open: species, quantity and condition of the reclaimed lot are unknown. The passport row Status reads «planlagt». D13 foregrounds reclaimed heartwood pine as a design intention. Species and condition of the boards are subject to sourcing.

claim_nb: Eik brukes i terskler og vindusbrett.
claim_en: Oak is used in thresholds and window boards.
allowed_nb: «Eik er planlagt i terskler og vindusbrett.»
allowed_en: Oak is planned for thresholds and window boards.
notes: The canonical house has black window frames (fase4/promo/canonical-house.md §2.3, decisions D8), so oak is window boards and thresholds, never frames or «karmer». Carlos's material brief names oak, but no repo record confirms the species or the supplier. Structural use only after the engineer confirms. D13 specifies European oak as the intended species in the concept palette.

claim_nb: Huset bruker ikke trykkimpregnert tre.
claim_en: The house uses no pressure-treated timber.
source: fase4/promo/decisions.md · Canonical house questions (pressure treatment: «Not sure yet»)
notes: No claim either way. The material passport row «Behandling» reads «ikke bestemt». C-08 settles it, including whether earlier boards were treated.

claim_nb: Badet ligger i den ene enden av huset.
claim_en: The bathroom is at one end of the house.
allowed_en: Bathroom at one end (concept).
notes: R0 puts the bathroom in a strip x ≈ 0–1.2 m. The renders show a deeper room, so they are captioned as material mood until the R1 plan confirms the size (decisions D8).

claim_nb: Badet har dusj, toalett og vask.
claim_en: The bathroom has a shower, toilet and basin.
allowed_en: Bath with shower, toilet and basin (concept).
notes: Fixtures come from the concept images only; no equipment inventory exists (C-07).

claim_nb: Huset har kjøkken, sittebenk og oppbevaring.
claim_en: The house has a kitchen, a bench seat and storage.
allowed_en: Kitchen, bench seat and storage (concept).
notes: The interior is described from the cabin-interior concept image; no joinery is designed. The canonical interior visual brief lists a cushioned bench, deep drawers, a timber worktop and muted kitchen fronts. Describe them as details in the drawings.

claim_nb: MiniHouse er laget for Bergen og Vestlandet.
claim_en: MiniHouse is made for Bergen and Western Norway.
allowed_en: Made for Bergen and Western Norway.
notes: This is a market decision, not a site permit. The plot is not chosen. Do not say «designet i Bergen» (not recorded).

claim_nb: Huset trenger ingen byggesøknad.
claim_en: The house needs no building permit.
allowed_nb: «Det avhenger av hva huset skal brukes til, og det er kommunen som avgjør.»
allowed_en: It depends on how the house will be used, and the municipality decides.
notes: C-01 is open and the municipality decides. No offer of help, no «søknadsfritt», no «unntatt fra TEK17», no promise that we will sort it out: the site states the dependency and stops there.

claim_nb: Huset oppfyller TEK17 / har U-verdi 0,xx.
claim_en: The house meets TEK17 / has a U-value of 0.xx.
notes: The envelope screen uses generic material data and no chosen product; no build-up is frozen (fase1/verificacion-envolvente.md). No U-value, no energy figure, no «TEK17-godkjent».

claim_nb: Prisen er …
claim_en: The price is …
notes: D2 is superseded by D10: there is no price and no «Pris kommer». MiniHouse is not for sale, so the site never mentions a price, a cost estimate or ordering.

claim_nb: Prototypen blir ferdig …
claim_en: The prototype will be ready …
allowed_nb: «Det vet vi ikke ennå. Følg prosjektet, så sier vi fra.»
allowed_en: We do not know yet. Follow the project and we will say so.
notes: There is no production plan. After D10 the FAQ asks about the prototype, not about getting a house; never give a date, and never imply that a finished prototype can be bought.

claim_nb: Huset veier …
claim_en: The house weighs …
source: fase1/registro-decisiones.md C-07; PROJECT.md · Base de diseño (Masa de traslado)
notes: No mass inventory and no weighing. The 3000 kg example in the report is hypothetical (rules.md §3) and must never appear as the module's mass.

claim_nb: Huset er under utvikling og ikke bygget.
claim_en: The house is under development and not built.
allowed_en: The house is under development.
notes: Status sentence in the hero and the footer. Update the date when a phase closes.

claim_nb: Alle bilder er konseptbilder.
claim_en: All images are concept images.
allowed_en: Concept image.
notes: Caption below every image of the house, never on top of it. A render without it does not ship.

claim_nb: Kledningen er en ventilert regnskjerm.
claim_en: The cladding is a ventilated rainscreen.
allowed_nb: «Kledningen er tenkt som en ventilert regnskjerm.»
allowed_en: The cladding is planned as a ventilated rainscreen.
notes: A design principle for Bergen wind-driven rain, not a tested detail. No performance number. «Tenkt som» carries the planned status.

claim_nb: Hvert parti gjenbrukt tre dokumenteres per parti.
claim_en: Each reclaimed lot is documented per lot.
allowed_en: The material passport is filled in per lot.
notes: Traceability before installation is required and nothing is documented yet. Never invent a lot number or an origin.

claim_nb: Huset har kobberdetaljer, blant annet på badet.
claim_en: The house has copper details, including in the bathroom.
allowed_en: Copper details (concept)
notes: From the bathroom concept images (the copper mirror); the design guide also lists copper as a passport material. No fitting, alloy or supplier is specified.

claim_nb: Følge-skjemaet sender opplysningene til …
claim_en: The follow form sends your details to …
notes: D6 is open: no inbox and no form service chosen. The privacy page (D-5), the consent copy and the form's success state stay BLOCKED until D6 is answered; never invent a provider or an address. The current preview has no sign-up form. Its privacy text describes this browsing experience.

claim_nb: Huset er i én etasje.
claim_en: The house is one storey.
allowed_en: One storey.
notes: R0 is one storey without a basement; no loft is possible with the current section (registro §N).

claim_nb: Tegninger og beregninger pågår, og prototypen er ikke bygget.
claim_en: Drawings and calculations are in progress, and the prototype is not built.
allowed_nb: «Tegninger og beregninger pågår. Prototypen er ikke bygget.»
allowed_en: Drawings and calculations are in progress. The prototype is not built.
notes: Buyer-facing plain words only: «Fase 0–4» and the phase names belong to the documents, never to the page. The status list uses «første utkast klart», «pågår», «ikke bygget», «under arbeid». Read the checkbox state in PROJECT.md before publishing and add the date you read it.

claim_nb: Ca. 3 m bredde ligger innenfor 3,25 m for udelt gods, men ruten må sjekkes.
claim_en: About 3 m is within the 3.25 m indivisible-cargo limit, but the route must be checked.
allowed_nb: «Ca. 3 m bredde ligger innenfor 3,25 m for udelt gods, men ruten må sjekkes.»
allowed_en: About 3 m is within the 3.25 m indivisible-cargo limit, but the route must be checked.
notes: Never used on the buyer page without K-05, because the height screen still exceeds 4.00 m in the 20° reference case of the height screening (registro §M, §N) — the pitch is not fixed: width alone must never suggest «it fits on the road». A 2026-11-16 screening, not a permit; vegliste, veggruppe and the carrier confirm each move.

claim_nb: Dokumentasjonssiden er publisert på minihouse-docs.canner.app.
claim_en: The documentation site is published at minihouse-docs.canner.app.
allowed_en: A «For professionals» link to the documentation site.
notes: The lab at minihouse-lab.canner.app is planned, not live; link it only after PLAN 6.1. Check both URLs return 200 before launch.

claim_nb: Kontakt: …
claim_en: Contact: …
notes: No e-mail address, phone number or company name is recorded in the repo. `footer.contact` is an empty string on purpose and the page renders nothing for it (check_promo counts it as omitted); never invent or reuse an old address.

claim_nb: Du får oppdateringer når det skjer noe i prosjektet, aldri mer enn én e-post i måneden, og hver e-post har en lenke for å melde seg av.
claim_en: You get updates when something happens in the project, never more than one e-mail a month, and every e-mail has an unsubscribe link.
allowed_nb: «Du får oppdateringer når det skjer noe i prosjektet, aldri mer enn én e-post i måneden, og hver e-post har en lenke for å melde seg av.»
allowed_en: You get updates when something happens in the project, never more than one e-mail a month, and every e-mail has an unsubscribe link.
notes: The privacy page must state this (D-5). The mechanism is planned, not built: D6 must choose the service and confirm the one-a-month ceiling with Carlos. Use the subscription language only after the service goes live.

claim_nb: Huset er ikke til salgs.
claim_en: The house is not for sale.
allowed_en: The house is not for sale.
notes: D10: no price, no ordering, no sales wording, no FINN ad. The FAQ answers «Er huset til salgs?» with this, never with a price or a waiting list.

claim_nb: Skjemaet spør bare om e-post og navn.
claim_en: The form asks only for an e-mail address and a name.
allowed_en: An e-mail address and a name. Nothing else.
notes: E-mail is required, the name optional, and the consent checkbox is unticked by default. Never add municipality, use, timeline or message fields back.

claim_nb: Døren og vindusrammene er tegnet i svart, og kledningen er værgrå.
claim_en: The door and window frames are drawn in black, and the cladding is weathered grey.
allowed_nb: «Døren og vindusrammene er tegnet i svart.» · «værgrå bord»
allowed_en: The door and window frames are shown in black. · weathered boards
notes: The canonical house fixes a solid black door, black frames and silver-brown weathered cladding, with a slim steel base. It is a design decision for the concept, not a built fact: keep «tegnet» or «i skissen». The petrol-green bathroom tile is the only tile colour recorded; never write «mørke fliser».

claim_nb: Furu har rødbrun kjerneved. Kjerneved av furu brukes tradisjonelt utvendig i Norge.
claim_en: Pine has reddish-brown heartwood. Pine heartwood has a history of exterior use in Norway.
source: Norsk Treteknisk Institutt, Fokus på tre 34, Furu (https://www.treteknisk.no/resources/6.-publikasjoner/1.-fokus-pa-tre/Fokus-nr-34-1.pdf); Riksantikvaren, Materialkvalitet (2023), p. 6 (https://riksantikvaren.no/content/uploads/2023/04/Materialkvalitet_tre_veileder.pdf)
allowed_en: reddish-brown heartwood
notes: Material description only. Species intent and sourcing are governed by K-07.

claim_nb: Filmen er en konseptfilm.
claim_en: The film is a concept film.
source: images/minihouse_walkthrough_v18_4k.mp4 (Carlos's 4K concept master, 3840x2160, 408 frames, 17.041 s, replaced 2026-11-18); cuts by scripts/cut_film.py: house-film-1920.mp4 1920x1080, house-film.mp4 1280x720, living-loop.mp4 1440x960, bath-loop.mp4 1080x1350; web/promo/src/content/films.json; fase4/promo/decisions.md D8
allowed_en: Concept film.
notes: Caption below every film on the site, next to its pause button, like K-20 for images. The film is rendered, silent and loops; it is not a recording of a built house. Added by Claude Code at Carlos's request (2026-11-18); DeepSeek reviews. Source re-pointed to the v18 4K master on 2026-11-18 (D-15, task-film-v18.md); the v11 cuts are archived in fase4/promo/archive/film-v11/.

claim_nb: I 2026 var jeg med på rivingen av den gamle lærerboligen til Midtun skole i Øvsttunvegen 21 i Bergen.
claim_en: In 2026 I was involved in the demolition of the old Midtun School teachers' residence at Øvsttunvegen 21 in Bergen.
source: Carlos's own account (agents/task-story-page.md Appendix A, 2026-11-18); totalbyggoganlegg.no/ovsttunvegen/, read 2026-11-18
allowed_nb: «I 2026 var jeg med på rivingen av den gamle lærerboligen …»
allowed_en: "In 2026, I was involved in the demolition of the old Midtun School Teachers' Residence …"
notes: First-person account, published as he wrote it. The reference page confirms the 2026 demolition by Totalentreprenør AS. Story page only.

claim_nb: Øvsttunvegen 21 var en gammel lærerbolig som ble revet i 2026; 43 tonn materialer og 46 tonn naturstein ble tatt vare på, med 52 % gjenbruk.
claim_en: Øvsttunvegen 21 was an old teachers' residence demolished in 2026; 43 tonnes of materials and 46 tonnes of natural stone were preserved, with a 52% reuse rate.
source: https://totalbyggoganlegg.no/ovsttunvegen/, read 2026-11-18: «2026: … river taket og den øverste etasjen utelukkende ved bruk av brekkjern. 43 tonn med byggematerialer av god kvalitet blir tatt vare på og det oppnås en gjenbruksgrad på hele 52 %. … 46 tonn med naturstein»
allowed_en: "the old teachers' residence" · "the demolition"
notes: The figures are verified on the reference page but do not appear in Carlos's text, so they are not published. **Never state or imply that MiniHouse uses timber from Øvsttunvegen**; the story does not say so, and K-06 keeps reclaimed timber out of the load-bearing structure.

claim_nb: Eiendommen skulle utvikles videre, og planen var å oppføre et nytt bygg på samme tomt med utgangspunkt i den opprinnelige bygningens arkitektoniske uttrykk og form.
claim_en: The property was being redeveloped, with a new building planned for the site that would preserve the architectural character and form of the original.
source: Carlos's own account (Appendix A); https://totalbyggoganlegg.no/ovsttunvegen/, read 2026-11-18: «det blir gitt lov til å rive bygget, under forutsetning av at huset bygges opp igjen i tilnærmet identisk form og stil»
allowed_nb: «planen var å oppføre et nytt bygg på samme tomt …»
allowed_en: "a new building planned for the site …"
notes: The reference page states the condition attached to the demolition permit in its own words; Carlos's text says the plan preserved the character and form. Both agree, so the wording stands. Story page only.

claim_nb: Et av målene med prosjektet var å gjenbruke så mye som mulig av de eksisterende byggematerialene.
claim_en: One of the redevelopment project's objectives was to reuse as much of the existing building material as possible.
source: Carlos's own account (Appendix A); https://totalbyggoganlegg.no/ovsttunvegen/, read 2026-11-18 (52 % gjenbruk, 43 tonn materialer, 46 tonn naturstein)
allowed_nb: «Et av målene med prosjektet var å gjenbruke så mye som mulig …»
allowed_en: "One of the redevelopment project's objectives was to reuse as much …"
notes: Carlos attributes the goal to the redevelopment project, not to himself, and that is how the copy keeps it. Story page only.

claim_nb: MiniHouse er tenkt som små, prefabrikkerte beredskapsboliger for mennesker rammet av kriser eller naturkatastrofer.
claim_en: MiniHouse is intended as small, prefabricated emergency homes for people affected by emergencies or natural disasters.
source: Carlos's own account (Appendix A); fase4/promo/decisions.md D11 as amended 2026-11-18 («Story page only»)
allowed_nb: «beredskapsboliger» · «midlertidige boliger for mennesker som er rammet av krisesituasjoner, naturkatastrofer …»
allowed_en: "emergency homes" · "temporary accommodation for people affected by emergencies, natural disasters …"
notes: Emergency words are allowed **only under story.*** (never in story.teaser, the home page, or the menu), per D11 as amended. The purpose is an intention, not a built fact.

claim_nb: Boligene skal bygges rundt en bærekonstruksjon som tåler transport og gjør det mulig å løfte hele boligen med kran.
claim_en: The houses are built around a structural frame designed for transport and for lifting the whole house by crane.
source: Carlos's own account (Appendix A); fase4/promo/content/claims-register.csv K-05; PROJECT.md (intro)
allowed_nb: «konstruert for å tåle transport og gjøre det mulig å løfte og flytte hele boligen ved hjelp av en kran»
allowed_en: "designed to make them strong enough for transportation and suitable for lifting and relocation by crane"
notes: Same goal as K-05, in Carlos's words: no route, crane or lift plan is verified. Story page only.

claim_nb: Alle materialer som skal brukes på nytt, blir kontrollert og vurdert ut fra hva de egner seg til.
claim_en: Every material that is reused is checked and assessed for what it is suitable for.
source: Carlos's own account (Appendix A); fase4/promo/content/claims-register.csv K-22; knowledge/comparisons/module-brief.md §3
allowed_nb: «blir kontrollert og vurdert ut fra hva de egner seg til»
allowed_en: "would need to be assessed for its suitability"
notes: A planned process, not a certified one. Structural safety, insulation, moisture protection and durability stay part of the work, as Carlos writes. Story page only.

claim_nb: Første steg er å bygge en prototype som er grundig planlagt, dimensjonert og testet.
claim_en: The first step is to build a prototype that is properly planned, dimensioned and tested.
source: Carlos's own account (Appendix A); fase4/promo/content/claims-register.csv K-19, K-26
allowed_nb: «Første steg blir å bygge en prototype som er grundig planlagt, dimensjonert og testet.»
allowed_en: "starting with one properly engineered prototype"
notes: The prototype exists as a plan only (K-19). No date. Story page only.

claim_nb: Carlos' egne vurderinger, publisert ordrett på historiens side.
claim_en: Carlos's own views, published verbatim on the story page.
source: Carlos's own account (Appendix A, 2026-11-18); fase4/promo/decisions.md, his answer «Keep my words»
allowed_nb: De fem setningene med «bærekraftig» eller «erfaring»: «For meg handler prosjektet om å kombinere beredskap, ingeniørfag, bærekraftig bygging og sirkulærøkonomi.» · «Hvis konseptet fungerer, kan MiniHouse etter hvert bli en praktisk løsning for å gi egnede rivningsmaterialer nytt liv som trygge og bærekraftige beredskapsboliger.»
allowed_en: "That experience made me ask myself a simple question:" · "It's about bringing together emergency preparedness, engineering, sustainable construction and the circular economy." · "If the concept works, MiniHouse could eventually become a practical way to transform suitable demolition materials into safe, sustainable emergency housing."
notes: These are Carlos's own views, kept as written (his answer: «Keep my words»). They are the only place where «bærekraftig» / "sustainable" and one of the "experience" uses are allowed, and only under story.*. The reuse facts behind them are K-06 and K-22; the emergency purpose is K-40 (intensjon).
